description: Factorial with overflow checking. Limited to n <= 20 because 21! exceeds i64. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/math/factorial — verified factorial'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm and std/math/safe_mul.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm and std/math/safe_mul.mm already use (checked_add, checked_sub, checked_mul, safe_narrow, conditional expressions).

atoms.name: factorial_step
atoms.description: Single inductive step of factorial: given the running product acc for n-1, multiply by n. Requires acc * n to fit in i64, expressed by bounding both operands.

atoms.name: factorial_in_range
atoms.description: Predicate that n is within the factorial-safe range [0, 20]. Returns 1 when n is representable, 0 otherwise.
